text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After an outing together, Ines Fujin<n>and I run into
Mr. C.B. in the shopping<n>district.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I saw your last scrimmage! I<n>couldn't believe
my eyes when you<n>came charging in from behind!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Really? Hehe. I'm glad you enjoyed<n>my
performance.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to surprise the crowd like that<n>too. Like, how
about if... instead of<n>pacing myself like a normal
front<n>runner, I just went full pelt from start<n>to
finish?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin chats away to Mr. C.B<n>with a starstruck
twinkle in her eye.<n>Watching the two of them, I
can't<n>help but think...
choice_data_list:
You're the very picture of an admiring
underclassman...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, how could I not be?! C.B.is my upperclassman! I look up to her,and I want to show it properly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do you have time to be standing<n>around
talking like this? If you have<n>any plans or...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm just doing some shopping. I<n>thought it might be
nice to cook for<n>myself more often, so I'm here to
pick out some quality produce.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But since I don't usually go to the<n>trouble, I haven't
had much luck<n>finding what's on my list so far. I
was just wandering about when you<n>bumped into
me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's getting late, though, isn't it?<n>Some of the shops
will probably start<n>closing soon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right. Well, that's not good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind, I could help<n>you with that! As
your<n>underclassman, I'd like to offer you<n>my
support!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I had no idea you could buy<n>breadcrumbs
from the butcher. And I<n>bought one of these
croquettes I've<n>heard so much about too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, look at these flowers.<n>Apparently, they were
planted by<n>some local elementary school kids.<n>How
pretty.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, C.B.! Your croquette is<n>still in the
fryer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wow, C.B. is a bit of a... a free spirit,<n>isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, she's gone again... C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look at these. It's a pair of retro<n>roller skates from
that toy store over<n>there. I've never seen skates
this old<n>before.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You bought these?! You shouldn't<n>waste your
money like that—not when<n>you still have ingredients
to buy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While chasing after the free-spirited<n>Mr. C.B., Ines
Fujin's nervous<n>disposition gradually fades away
until<n>she's practically back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ines, look! Roasted sweet potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No sweet potatoes for you! You just<n>had that
croquette, didn't you? You<n>won't have any space
for dinner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I'm so, so, so sorry! I can'tbelieve I just spoke to anupperclassman like that...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Aha ha! You're a funny person,<n>Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine. Don't worry about it. I<n>don't go in
for social norms like the<n>whole "act proper in front
of your<n>upperclassmen" thing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I approach my races the same way.<n>Going against
the norm is how you<n>seize greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Roger that! Thanks for the<n>insight!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though Ines panicked for a moment<n>after
unwittingly acting like a big<n>sister to her
upperclassman,<n>everything seems to have turned
out<n>all right.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it looks like that behavior<n>might actually be
opening up new<n>opportunities for her.
choice_data_list: Let's take your big sister act up a notch!
Today, let's be free spirits like C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I tell Ines Fujin that Mister C.B. is<n>right, and it's
about time she<n>unleashed her real personality in full
force!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But don't you think that'd be a<n>little too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me. But I think I'm<n>going to make a
pretty unruly little<n>sister, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I'd like one of those<n>potatoes please.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ack, what did I say about leaving<n>space for dinner?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there, Trainer! Help<n>me out!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even in front of her upperclassman,<n>Ines Fujin
remains entirely herself. It<n>looks like this was a
great learning<n>experience for her!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I guess we're eating out for<n>dinner tonight.
I'll leave the cooking<n>for tomorrow—wouldn't want
to pass<n>up this opportunity to hang out with<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Does that actually constitute going<n>against social
norms?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. But it's always fun to<n>follow through
on your desires in the<n>moment.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Follow through on your desires...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I know just the thing, C.B.! For<n>dinner, let's have
a bowl of ramen!<n>And to top it off...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll race you to the restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you desire right now.<n>Hehe, you're
on, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I watch the two of them dashing<n>off so
earnestly into the evening, I<n>can't help feeling that
they're<n>actually kind of similar.
